quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Afternoon to close your eyes for a short, restful sleep"?
quests.question: Take a Nap
quests.hint: This happens in the middle of the day, not at night.
quests.explanation: Well done! Napping gives our busy bodies a little extra rest.
quests.funFact: Even grown-ups sometimes enjoy a short afternoon nap to feel refreshed!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to make a neat knot so your shoes stay snug"?
quests.question: Tie Shoelaces
quests.hint: This keeps your shoes snug so they won't slip off.
quests.explanation: That's right! Tying shoelaces means making a neat knot to keep shoes secure.
quests.funFact: Learning to tie your own shoelaces is a proud step toward getting ready all by yourself!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Afternoon to organize clean clothes into tidy little piles"?
quests.question: Fold the Laundry
quests.hint: Clean, dry clothes are turned into neat stacks for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We fold the laundry to turn clean clothes into neat stacks.
quests.funFact: Neatly folded clothes take up less space in a drawer or closet!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Anytime to take a cool sip and feel refreshed"?
quests.question: Drink Water
quests.hint: You often do this after running or playing outside.
quests.explanation: Well done! Water is what our busy bodies need to stay healthy.
quests.funFact: Your body needs water to help you think, play, and grow every day!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Midday to refuel with a tasty meal at school or home"?
quests.question: Eat Lunch
quests.hint: You often eat this at school, between classes.
quests.explanation: Well done! Eating lunch helps us feel ready for afternoon fun and learning.
quests.funFact: Eating a balanced lunch can help you stay focused for your afternoon classes!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to place your bag on its hook once you arrive at school"?
quests.question: Hang Up Your Backpack
quests.hint: You do this right after you arrive at school, not before you leave home.
quests.explanation: That's right! Hanging up a backpack means placing it neatly on a hook.
quests.funFact: Every student's hook or cubby is a special spot just for their own things!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to make dirty dishes sparkly clean again"?
quests.question: Wash the Dishes
quests.hint: Soap, water, and a sponge are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We wash the dishes after a meal to keep them clean.
quests.funFact: Some families take turns washing the dishes to help each other out!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to sit back and watch a fun program"?
quests.question: Watch Some TV
quests.hint: You might enjoy a cartoon or a favorite show during this time.
quests.explanation: Well done! A short show is a relaxing way to enjoy the evening.
quests.funFact: Watching a favorite show together can be a cozy family activity!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to walk along the sidewalk toward your school"?
quests.question: Walk to School
quests.hint: You do this after breakfast, on the way to your classroom.
quests.explanation: That's right! Walking to school is a great way to start the day.
quests.funFact: Looking both ways before crossing the street keeps you safe on your walk!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to select an outfit before you get dressed"?
quests.question: Choose Your Clothes
quests.hint: You look in your closet or drawer for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We choose our clothes in the morning before getting dressed.
quests.funFact: Picking your clothes the night before can make your morning much quicker!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to pour a little water into a plant's pot"?
quests.question: Water the Plants
quests.hint: You do this for something green sitting in a pot, not a pet.
quests.explanation: Well done! Plants need water, sunlight, and care to grow big and strong.
quests.funFact: Some houseplants only need a little water once or twice a week!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Anytime to keep sneaky germs from spreading to your food"?
quests.question: Wash Hands
quests.hint: You do this before meals and after playing outside.
quests.explanation: That's right! Washing our hands with soap keeps us healthy.
quests.funFact: Clean hands are one of the best ways to stay healthy and strong!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to stand in order with your classmates before class starts"?
quests.question: Line Up for Class
quests.hint: This happens right before you walk into your classroom together.
quests.explanation: That's right! Lining up means standing in a tidy row before class begins.
quests.funFact: Lining up in order helps everyone walk safely and calmly into the classroom!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to slip on your favorite pair before school"?
quests.question: Put on Shoes
quests.hint: You do this right before you walk out the door.
quests.explanation: Yes! We put on our shoes before we head outside for the day.
quests.funFact: Wearing the right shoes helps keep your feet safe while you run and play!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to fill a lunchbox with food for midday"?
quests.question: Pack a Lunch
quests.hint: You do this before school, but you eat the food much later.
quests.explanation: That's right! Packing a lunch means choosing food to eat later at school.
quests.funFact: Packing a colorful lunch with fruits and veggies can make lunchtime extra fun!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning and Night to chase away sneaky sugar bugs"?
quests.question: Brush Teeth
quests.hint: This keeps your smile sparkly and helps stop tiny tooth troubles.
quests.explanation: Correct! A clean smile starts with brushing our teeth every morning and night.
quests.funFact: Baby teeth need brushing too, even though new teeth will grow in later!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Afternoon to enjoy a small, tasty bite between meals"?
quests.question: Eat a Snack
quests.hint: You enjoy this between lunch and dinner.
quests.explanation: Well done! A healthy snack helps keep our energy up until dinner.
quests.funFact: Fruits like apples and grapes make a healthy and tasty afternoon snack!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to make sure every toy has found its own spot"?
quests.question: Put Away Your Toys
quests.hint: Bins, shelves, or toy boxes are where these end up.
quests.explanation: Yes! We put away our toys so each one has its own spot.
quests.funFact: A tidy toy shelf can help you find your favorite toy again in no time!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to make your hair neat and tidy"?
quests.question: Comb Hair
quests.hint: This smooths out the tangles that happen while you sleep.
quests.explanation: Well done! A quick comb helps our hair look neat before school.
quests.funFact: Hair can get tangled while you sleep, so a morning comb helps smooth it out!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to share a warm meal with your family"?
quests.question: Eat Dinner
quests.hint: A warm plate of food is a clue for this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! Eating dinner helps our body rest and refuel before bed.
quests.funFact: Sharing a meal together is a lovely time to talk about your favorite part of the day!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning when the sun comes up and it's time to get moving"?
quests.question: Wake Up
quests.hint: You do this before you even get out of bed.
quests.explanation: Correct! Waking up gets us ready for a whole day of learning and play.
quests.funFact: Getting enough sleep at night helps you wake up feeling happy and ready to play!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to stand at your stop until the bus arrives"?
quests.question: Wait for the Bus
quests.hint: This happens before you climb aboard, not after.
quests.explanation: That's right! Waiting for the bus means standing patiently until it comes.
quests.funFact: Standing back from the curb while you wait helps keep you safe until the bus arrives!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Afternoon to sit down and complete your school assignments"?
quests.question: Do Homework
quests.hint: A pencil and a quiet space help with this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We do homework in the afternoon to practice what we learned.
quests.funFact: Doing a little homework each day can help new lessons stick in your memory!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to reach your arms up high and wake your body"?
quests.question: Stretch Your Body
quests.hint: You do this gently, often right after you get out of bed.
quests.explanation: Well done! A gentle morning stretch can help us feel more awake.
quests.funFact: Even animals like cats and dogs love a good stretch after a nap!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Afternoon to explore the backyard or park with friends"?
quests.question: Play Outside
quests.hint: This is active and usually happens outdoors, not inside.
quests.explanation: Well done! Fresh air and sunshine make playing outside extra fun.
quests.funFact: Sunshine and fresh air can help you feel happy and full of energy!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to wake up fresh and feel nice and clean"?
quests.question: Wash Face
quests.hint: It helps wake up your sleepy eyes.
quests.explanation: Well done! A splash of cool water is a great way to start the day.
quests.funFact: Cool water on your face can help you feel awake and alert in the morning!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to keep your toes warm and cozy all day"?
quests.question: Put on Socks
quests.hint: They can be striped, spotted, or your favorite color.
quests.explanation: That's right! Socks keep our toes cozy all day long.
quests.funFact: Cozy socks can help keep your whole body feeling warm on a chilly day!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Night to give a hug and share kind, cozy words"?
quests.question: Say Good Night
quests.hint: It's a warm, kind way to end the whole day.
quests.explanation: Correct! Saying good night helps everyone feel cozy before falling asleep.
quests.funFact: Families all around the world have their own special way of saying good night!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to ride along a route that ends at school"?
quests.question: Ride the Bus
quests.hint: You share this ride with many other students.
quests.explanation: That's right! Riding the bus is one way many students travel to school.
quests.funFact: Riding the bus with friends is a fun way to start the school day!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Night to change into soft, comfy clothes for sleeping"?
quests.question: Put on Pajamas
quests.hint: These clothes often have fun patterns like stars or stripes.
quests.explanation: Well done! Putting on pajamas helps us feel snug and ready for bed.
quests.funFact: Many pajamas are covered in fun patterns like stars, stripes, or favorite animals!
